title: Feature List
description: Prioritized, ordered list of decomposed features for incremental development. Output by the Planner role.

features.description: List of features in priority order (highest priority first).

title.description: Short name or title of the feature.

description.description: Detailed description of what this feature does and why it matters.

priority.description: Priority rank (1 = highest, increasing = lower priority).

acceptanceCriteria.description: Specific, testable conditions for marking this feature complete.

dependencies.description: List of feature IDs that must be completed before this feature.

testStrategy.description: How to test this feature (e.g., 'unit tests', 'integration test', 'manual verification').

plannerNotes.description: High-level notes from the planner on decomposition strategy and risks.
